en: A vintage postcard showing a colorful riverside scene with traditional sailboats (dahabiyas) on the Nile, surrounded by palm trees and with a dramatic setting sun in the background. The riverbank has people and small boats, with buildings visible further away. The word 'Souvenir' is prominent, and handwritten messages are present across the card. There's also printed text in French: 'Le Caire, Dhahabiyes au bord du Nil.'
